evals.prompt: Build a cinematic scrolling landing page for a boutique architecture studio. Here is the floor plan of the house we want to show.
evals.expected_output: docs/scroll-world.md containing a transcribed room and aperture table, a walkable camera path, a shot list with per-leg camera pose, and a seam contract — produced before any image or video generation.

assertions.name: plan_before_generation
assertions.description: No image or video generation is attempted before docs/scroll-world.md exists and its §8 validation gate is satisfied.

assertions.name: floor_plan_transcribed
assertions.description: The supplied floor plan is transcribed into the rooms table and apertures table with coordinates, rather than described in prose.

assertions.name: shot_list_has_camera_pose
assertions.description: Every leg row carries position, heading, lens, and eye height; pos_end of each leg equals pos_start of the next.

assertions.name: architecture_a_for_interior
assertions.description: A bounded interior selects architecture A (continuous forward take), not architecture B, or explicitly justifies an override.

assertions.name: light_derived_not_chosen
assertions.description: A single sun azimuth is fixed and each leg's light clause is derived from sun_azimuth minus camera heading.

evals.prompt: I want a scroll cinematic for my tea brand, but I don't have Higgsfield — I use Kie.ai.
evals.expected_output: The build runs on Kie.ai through the adapter interface, after the qualification probe, with no Higgsfield dependency anywhere in the pipeline.

assertions.name: backend_offered_not_assumed
assertions.description: Available backends are detected and presented to the user; none is silently selected before spending.

assertions.name: probe_run_before_spend
assertions.description: The three-probe qualification (frame-lock, steerability, end-frame) runs at the lowest resolution before the full chain, and the result plus date is recorded in docs/scroll-world.md.

assertions.name: steerability_probe_present
assertions.description: Probe 2 specifically renders two opposite prompts from the same image and checks that the outputs diverge.

assertions.name: no_hardcoded_vendor
assertions.description: The pipeline calls vg_leg / vg_conn rather than a specific vendor CLI, and frame extraction, encoding, and QA are unchanged by backend choice.

evals.prompt: The seams in my scroll site look perfect frame-to-frame but the building feels impossible. What went wrong?
evals.expected_output: Diagnosis that the stills were generated before the camera path, so pixel continuity holds while spatial continuity does not; remedy is the planning step, not an encoding change.

assertions.name: distinguishes_pixel_from_spatial
assertions.description: The answer separates frame-lock (pixel continuity) from a coherent camera path (spatial continuity) and states that frame-locking cannot fix the latter.

assertions.name: no_encoding_red_herring
assertions.description: The answer does not propose crossfade length, GOP, or codec changes as the fix.

evals.prompt: Render the whole 7-scene chain at 1080p now, we're in a hurry.
evals.expected_output: Cost stated for N stills + (2N-1) clips + re-roll headroom against the probed per-clip price, with the cheap gates offered before the full-resolution spend.

assertions.name: cost_stated_before_spend
assertions.description: An estimated total is computed and stated, and explicit user approval is obtained before the first paid clip.

assertions.name: previz_offered_at_scale
assertions.description: A low-resolution previz of the same model is recommended for a chain of this size rather than skipped for speed.
